resources.string: Kineograph can run Google\'s Gemma 4 model on this phone, with no internet connection. Download a Gemma 4 model in LiteRT-LM format (a file ending in .litertlm, about 2.6 GB) with your browser, then import it here. The app keeps its own copy, so you can delete the download afterwards.
